scripts.deploy: npm run test:run && npm run build && bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d); trap "git worktree remove --force \"$TMP_DIR\" 2>/dev/null || rm -rf \"$TMP_DIR\"" EXIT; git worktree add --detach "$TMP_DIR"; cp -R dist/. "$TMP_DIR/"; cd "$TMP_DIR"; git add -A; git commit -m "Deploy update"; git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/prod --force'
